entities.summary: Ireland is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Dublin. Official languages include Irish (Gaeilge), English. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 5.3 million. Area: 70,273 km². Comprehensive index for Ireland covering Celtic civilisation, early Christianity (St. Patrick ~432 CE, 'Island of Saints and Scholars'), Viking invasions (Dublin founded ~841), Norman invasion (1169), English/British rule (Plantation of Ulster, Penal Laws), Great Famine 1845-52 (1M died, 1M emigrated), Easter Rising 1916, War of Independence 1919-21, partition (1921-22, Irish Free State/Northern Ireland), Civil War 1922-23, Republic 1949, Troubles (NI), Celtic Tiger (1995-2007), 2008 crash, and modern social transformation.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ireland's complex history has shaped its modern identity through significant regional and thematic impact, including the Easter Rising and War of Independence, which led to the establishment of the Irish Free State and ultimately the Republic of Ireland.
